shared_elements: oversized elongated block-like head with flat top
long straight-sided torso tapering to a base
arms held tight against the sides of the body
prominent ear/jaw ridges framing the head
horizontal band across the lower torso (belt/collar line)
small circular/disc motifs on the torso
justification: Both depict the same distinctive figure type: a colossal, squared-off humanoid with an oversized flat-topped head, heavy straight jaw/ear ridges, a long tapering torso with arms clamped to the sides and small disc-like markings, and a horizontal band across the lower body \u2014 proportions and schematic conventions match closely enough to look like the same tradition (indeed possibly the same figure seen from opposite sides). The main difference in depicted content is that one surface presents the facial features (brow, nose, chin, nipples) while the other presents a back covered with additional incised curvilinear and ring motifs that have no counterpart on the first.
